title: CDS Full Length Mock Test 08 (Hard Level)
description: Combined Defence Services Examination style full-length mock covering English, Elementary Mathematics and General Knowledge. Hard level, 100 questions.
instructions: There is a penalty of 0.83 marks for every wrong answer.
No marks will be deducted for unattempted questions.
Choose the most appropriate option among the four given choices.
The paper covers English, Elementary Mathematics and General Knowledge as in CDS.
Use of calculator or electronic device is not permitted.

questions.subject: English
questions.question: Identify the part that contains an error: Each of the officers who / were detailed for the night patrol / have submitted / a separate after-action report.
options: were detailed for the night patrol
questions.explanation: The subject of the main clause is 'Each' (singular), so the verb must be 'has submitted'.

questions.subject: English
questions.question: Identify the error: No sooner the column entered / the defile than / small-arms fire / opened from both flanks.
questions.explanation: Correct construction requires inversion: 'No sooner had the column entered...'.

questions.subject: English
questions.question: Identify the error: The number of sorties flown / during the exercise / were far higher / than originally planned.
questions.explanation: 'The number' is singular; use 'was far higher'.

questions.subject: English
questions.question: Identify the error: He suggested that the convoy / should be divided into / two packets so that / neither of them are an easy target.
options: neither of them are an easy target.
questions.explanation: 'Neither' takes a singular verb: 'neither of them is an easy target'.

questions.subject: English
questions.question: Choose the best improvement: The brigade was ordered to hold the ridgeline at all costs.
options: hold the ridgeline by all costs
hold the ridgeline on all costs
hold the ridgeline for all costs
questions.explanation: The idiom 'at all costs' is already correct.

questions.subject: English
questions.question: The patrol returned back to the harbour area at first light.
options: returned back into the harbour area
had returned back to the harbour area
questions.explanation: 'Returned back' is tautological; 'returned to' is sufficient.

questions.subject: English
questions.question: If the weather would have been clearer, the drop would have been executed as planned.
options: If the weather had been clearer
If the weather would be clearer
If the weather was being clearer
questions.explanation: Third conditional requires 'If + past perfect': 'If the weather had been clearer'.

questions.subject: English
questions.question: The commander insisted that the plan ______ before last light.
questions.explanation: After verbs of insistence the mandative subjunctive 'be finalised' is preferred.

questions.subject: English
questions.question: The two versions of the after-action report were so ______ that they might have been written by different units.
questions.explanation: 'Discrepant' means inconsistent or conflicting.

questions.subject: English
questions.question: Choose the synonym of INTRANSIGENT as used in: 'The opposing commander remained intransigent throughout the talks.'
questions.explanation: Intransigent means refusing to change one's position; uncompromising.

questions.subject: English
questions.question: Choose the synonym of REDOUND as used in: 'The success of the raid will redound to the credit of the whole battalion.'
questions.explanation: To redound to means to contribute to or result in (credit or honour).

questions.subject: English
questions.question: Choose the antonym of LACONIC.
questions.explanation: Laconic means using few words; verbose is wordy.

questions.subject: English
questions.question: Choose the antonym of SALUTARY.
questions.explanation: Salutary means producing a beneficial effect; harmful is the opposite.

questions.subject: English
questions.question: 'To throw down the gauntlet' means:
questions.explanation: The phrase means to challenge someone to a contest.

questions.subject: English
questions.question: 'To rest on one's oars' means:
options: to stop making effort after some success
to prepare for a long voyage
questions.explanation: It means to relax after an achievement instead of continuing to work.

questions.subject: English
questions.question: 'A storm in a teacup' refers to:
options: an exaggerated fuss over a trivial matter
questions.explanation: It denotes unnecessary agitation about something unimportant.

questions.subject: English
questions.question: 'To hold a brief for' someone means:
options: to keep a secret file on
questions.explanation: It means to speak or argue in favour of a person or cause.

questions.subject: English
questions.question: A person who is indifferent to pleasure and pain is called a:
questions.explanation: A stoic remains unmoved by pleasure or pain.

questions.subject: English
questions.question: A speech delivered without any previous preparation is:
questions.explanation: Extempore means spoken without preparation.

questions.subject: English
questions.question: Choose the correct passive: 'The engineers had already breached the obstacle.'
options: The obstacle has already been breached by the engineers.
The obstacle had already been breached by the engineers.
The obstacle was already being breached by the engineers.
The obstacle is already breached by the engineers.
questions.explanation: Past perfect active becomes past perfect passive: had already been breached.

questions.subject: English
questions.question: He said, 'I will brief the company at 0430 hours tomorrow.' Choose the correct reported speech.
options: He said that he will brief the company at 0430 hours the next day.
He said that he would brief the company at 0430 hours the next day.
He said that he would brief the company at 0430 hours tomorrow.
He said that I would brief the company at 0430 hours the next day.
questions.explanation: Will → would; tomorrow → the next day; pronoun I → he.

questions.subject: English
questions.question: Arrange P-Q-R-S to complete: The GOC directed that / P: before last light / Q: the minefield / R: be marked and recorded / S: on both sides of the axis
questions.explanation: Natural order: the minefield (Q) be marked and recorded (R) on both sides of the axis (S) before last light (P) → QRSP.

questions.subject: English
questions.question: The battalion was deployed ______ the river and the ridgeline.
questions.explanation: 'Between' is used for two clearly identified limits.

questions.subject: English
questions.question: ______ Himalayas form a natural barrier along India's northern frontier.
questions.explanation: Mountain ranges take the definite article: the Himalayas.

questions.subject: English
questions.question: A 'defile' in military terrain language is best described as:
options: an open plain suitable for armour
a narrow pass that constricts movement
questions.explanation: A defile is a narrow passage, typically between hills, that restricts manoeuvre.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.question: The remainder when 7^2026 is divided by 4 is:
questions.explanation: 7 ≡ −1 (mod 4), so 7^n ≡ (−1)^n (mod 4). Since 2026 is even, remainder = 1.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.question: If n = 2^4 × 3^2 × 5, the number of even factors of n is:
questions.explanation: Total factors = (4+1)(2+1)(1+1) = 30. Odd factors = (2+1)(1+1) = 6. Even factors = 30 − 6 = 24.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.question: The HCF of two numbers is 18 and their LCM is 504. If one number is 72, the other is:
questions.explanation: HCF × LCM = product of numbers ⇒ 18 × 504 = 72 × x ⇒ x = (18 × 504)/72 = 126.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.question: A quantity is first increased by 25% and then decreased by 20%. The net change is:
questions.explanation: Multiplier = 1.25 × 0.80 = 1.00; net change is zero.

questions.explanation: Speed = 54 × 5/18 = 15 m/s. Distance = 300 m. Time = 300/15 = 20 s.

questions.explanation: Relative speed = 9 km/h. Time = 27/9 = 3 h.

questions.subject: General Knowledge
questions.question: Which Article of the Constitution of India deals with the amendment procedure?
questions.explanation: Article 368 lays down the power of Parliament to amend the Constitution and the procedure thereof.

questions.subject: General Knowledge
questions.question: The concept of 'Judicial Review' in India is borrowed from the Constitution of:
questions.explanation: Judicial review as practised in India is primarily inspired by the US Constitution.

questions.subject: General Knowledge
questions.question: Who is the ex-officio Chairman of the Rajya Sabha?
questions.explanation: Article 64: the Vice-President is ex-officio Chairman of the Council of States.

questions.subject: General Knowledge
questions.question: The Finance Commission of India is constituted under which Article?
questions.explanation: Article 280 provides for a Finance Commission every five years.

questions.subject: General Knowledge
questions.question: Which of the following is a Fundamental Duty under Article 51A?
questions.explanation: Article 51A(i) requires every citizen to safeguard public property and to abjure violence.

questions.subject: General Knowledge
questions.question: The Battle of Plassey was fought in the year:
questions.explanation: Robert Clive defeated Siraj-ud-Daulah at Plassey on 23 June 1757.

questions.subject: General Knowledge
questions.question: Who among the following founded the Slave (Mamluk) dynasty in Delhi?
questions.explanation: Qutb-ud-din Aibak, a general of Muhammad Ghori, established the Slave dynasty in 1206.

questions.subject: General Knowledge
questions.question: The Third Battle of Panipat (1761) was fought between the Marathas and:
questions.explanation: Ahmad Shah Abdali (Durrani) defeated the Maratha confederacy at Panipat in 1761.

questions.explanation: Gandhi gave the 'Do or Die' call at the launch of the Quit India Movement in August 1942.

questions.subject: General Knowledge
questions.question: Who presided over the Lahore Session of the Indian National Congress in 1929?
questions.explanation: Jawaharlal Nehru presided; the session adopted the Purna Swaraj resolution.

questions.subject: General Knowledge

questions.subject: General Knowledge
questions.question: Which river is known as the 'Sorrow of Bihar'?

questions.subject: General Knowledge

questions.explanation: Anamudi (2,695 m) in Kerala is the highest peak of the Western Ghats.

questions.subject: General Knowledge

questions.subject: General Knowledge
questions.question: Black cotton soils (regur) of the Deccan are mainly derived from:
questions.explanation: Regur develops on Deccan Trap basalt.

questions.subject: General Knowledge
questions.question: Which body in India is responsible for conducting the Census?
questions.explanation: The Office of the Registrar General and Census Commissioner, under the Home Ministry, conducts the Census.

questions.subject: General Knowledge
questions.question: GST in India is administered as a:
questions.explanation: India follows a dual GST model with CGST, SGST/UTGST and IGST.

questions.subject: General Knowledge
questions.question: The repo rate is the rate at which:
options: RBI lends to commercial banks against securities
banks lend to each other overnight
questions.explanation: Repo is the rate at which the RBI injects liquidity by lending to banks against collateral.

questions.subject: General Knowledge
questions.question: The SI unit of luminous intensity is:
questions.explanation: Candela (cd) is the SI base unit of luminous intensity.

questions.subject: General Knowledge
questions.question: Which of the following is a vector quantity?
questions.explanation: Momentum (p = mv) has both magnitude and direction.

questions.subject: General Knowledge
questions.question: The pH of a neutral aqueous solution at 25°C is:
questions.explanation: At 25°C, [H+] = 10⁻⁷ mol/L, so pH = 7.

questions.subject: General Knowledge
questions.question: Which gas is the major constituent of biogas?
questions.explanation: Biogas is typically 50–70% methane.

questions.subject: General Knowledge

questions.subject: General Knowledge

questions.subject: General Knowledge
questions.question: The headquarters of the Indian Army's Northern Command is located at:
questions.explanation: Northern Command HQ is at Udhampur, Jammu and Kashmir.

questions.subject: General Knowledge
questions.question: INS Vikrant, commissioned in 2022, is India's first:
questions.explanation: IAC-1 INS Vikrant is India's first indigenously designed and built aircraft carrier.

questions.subject: General Knowledge
questions.question: The highest gallantry award in India during peacetime is:
questions.explanation: Ashoka Chakra is the peacetime equivalent of the Param Vir Chakra.

questions.subject: General Knowledge

questions.subject: General Knowledge

questions.explanation: Bharat Ratna was instituted in 1954.

questions.explanation: Nehru wrote it during his imprisonment at Ahmednagar Fort (1942–46).
